# See https://www.robotstxt.org/robotstxt.html for documentation on how to use the robots.txt file

# Allow all crawlers by default (Googlebot, Bingbot, DuckDuckBot, social-preview
# bots, etc.) so search engines can still index our public pages.
User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Disallow admin and private areas
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /users/
Disallow: /letter_opener/
Disallow: /mission-control/
Disallow: /jobs/
Disallow: /test/

# Keep the in-page search and pagination URLs out of the index; the pages
# themselves also emit `<meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow">`.
Disallow: /funny-fantasy-football-team-names*?q=
Disallow: /funny-fantasy-football-team-names*&q=

# Block optimizer URLs with search params from being indexed. Bingbot was
# crawling stale URLs like /optimizer?search=spam+keywords from its index,
# generating junk traffic. The optimizer requires auth so there is nothing
# useful to index here.
Disallow: /optimizer?*search=
Disallow: /more-stats

# Sortable-table and split-filter query params (MLB splits, stat leaders,
# pitcher matchup explorer, defensive rankings) are re-sorted/re-filtered
# views of the same underlying rows, not distinct content — indexing every
# sort/split combination wastes crawl budget for no ranking benefit.
Disallow: /*?sort_column=
Disallow: /*&sort_column=
Disallow: /*?sort_direction=
Disallow: /*&sort_direction=
Disallow: /*?sort=
Disallow: /*&sort=
Disallow: /*?dir=
Disallow: /*&dir=
Disallow: /*?split=
Disallow: /*&split=

# Bingbot is the noisiest crawler (~12% of request volume). Crawl-delay asks
# it to wait N seconds between requests. Google ignores Crawl-delay (use
# Google Search Console instead), so this targets Bing specifically.
# Per RFC 9309, a specific User-agent group overrides the wildcard group, so
# we must duplicate all Disallow rules here or bingbot would ignore them.
User-agent: bingbot
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /users/
Disallow: /letter_opener/
Disallow: /mission-control/
Disallow: /jobs/
Disallow: /test/
Disallow: /funny-fantasy-football-team-names*?q=
Disallow: /funny-fantasy-football-team-names*&q=
Disallow: /optimizer?*search=
Disallow: /more-stats
Disallow: /*?sort_column=
Disallow: /*&sort_column=
Disallow: /*?sort_direction=
Disallow: /*&sort_direction=
Disallow: /*?sort=
Disallow: /*&sort=
Disallow: /*?dir=
Disallow: /*&dir=
Disallow: /*?split=
Disallow: /*&split=
Crawl-delay: 5

# to train models without sending users back to us. They respect robots.txt and
# rotate IPs heavily, which makes IP-level bans ineffective — robots.txt is the
# authoritative opt-out mechanism. Keep this list in sync with BotDetector's
# `ai_scraper: true` signatures in app/services/bot_detector.rb.
